<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, you changed your mind? Just let me know if you

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)>I’m about to go to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> to do some
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>s. <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)>I hope you can come by later!
dialogues.pt_br:

<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>s. <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)>Espero que possas vir mais tarde!

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Hmmm... I wonder how this is used.
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Como será que isto é usado?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Really? Like, really really?! Wow, I can’t wait to taste it!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Sério? Tipo, realmente?! Uau, Mal posso esperar para prová-lo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Does it get bright because it’s morning? Or is it morning
because it gets bright...?
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>It’s such a complicated question!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Fica claro porque é de manhã? Ou é de manhã
Porque fica claro...?
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>É uma pergunta tão complicada!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Sometimes it really seems like my friends <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>get bored
listening to me talk...
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>I’m really not sure why... Me? I love talking!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Às vezes parece que os meus amigos <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>ficar entediado
Ouve-me falar...
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Eu realmente não tenho certeza por que... Eu? Eu amo conversar!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>You know how sometimes you can see the moon even
when the sun’s still going down?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Do you think that’s ’cause the moon accidentally woke up
too early?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>sabe como às vezes pode ver a lua
quando o sol ainda está se pondo?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Você acha que é porque a lua acidentalmente acordou
Muito cedo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Shooting stars are supposed to be falling stars, right?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder if the moon will ever fall like that.
<$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>I hope not... A shooting moon sounds terrifying.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>As estrelas cadentes deviam ser estrelas cadentes, certo?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Pergunto-me se a lua alguma vez cairá assim.
<$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Espero que não... uma lua de tiro parece aterrorizante.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Sometimes there’re spots on the ground where
something’s buried...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>I wonder what’s actually hidden there. Maybe it’s some
kind of amazing treasure! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Wouldn’t that be exciting?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Às vezes há pontos no chão onde
algo está enterrado...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu me pergunto o que está realmente escondido lá. Talvez seja algum
Um tesouro incrível! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Não seria emocionante?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>I tripped and fell the other day... I almost started crying,
but then <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>a nearby Pokémon came over to help me!
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>That made me so happy... <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope I can help in the same
way if I ever see a Pokémon in need!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Tropecei e caí no outro dia... quase comecei a chorar.
Mas depois... <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Um Pokémon nas proximidades veio ajudar-me!
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso fez-me tão feliz... <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Espero poder ajudar na mesma coisa.
Se alguma vez vir um Pokémon em necessidade!

<$cdef(27)>!

to
experience
so many
new things!

dialogues.pt_br:

<$cdef(27)>!

para
experiência
tantos

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Já terminamos? <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso foi tão rápido... Vamos fazer isso

something

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,65)><$voicel(1,4)>It’s very quiet in the water, isn’t it?
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>But it’s never boring because when I’m roaming around,
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>sometimes I hear someone’s voice from far away.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,65)><$voicel(1,4)>É muito calmo na água, não é?
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas nunca é chato porque quando estou vagando,
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>às vezes ouço a voz de alguém de longe.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Thanks to all the watering you did, <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>there’s lots of grass and
flowers now! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Thanks so much! <$pkcry;1(1,1)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Graças a toda a rega que fizeste, <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>há muita grama e
Flores agora! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Muito obrigado! <$pkcry;1(1,1)>!

dialogues.pt_br:

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu não podia me conter - eu tinha que mostrar para fora
Todos.
Só um pouco, no entanto!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You’re so amazing, <$cdef(27)>! You can
even
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>make
those

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Staying up late at night seems kinda scary... <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>But it could
also be fun, right? I wish I could give it a try...
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,3)>I’m more of a morning Pokémon though. Staying awake is
so hard... <$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)>*yawn*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Ficar acordado até tarde à noite parece assustador... <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas podia.
- gostaria de poder tentar...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>I wanna be more friendly with the Pokémon who’re up
during the day, but...<$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)> *yawn* I just get so sleepy <$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>once
the sun comes up...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu quero ser mais amigável com o Pokémon que está acima
durante o dia, mas...<$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)> Fico tão sonolento. <$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>uma vez
O sol nasce...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>When you fly up high, you get closer to the sun, right?
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>So I thought it’d get hotter the higher you go, but it
actually gets really cold!<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)> I wonder why...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando voas para cima, aproximas-te do sol, certo?
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Então eu pensei que ficaria mais quente quanto mais alto você vai, mas ele
Na verdade, fica muito frio!<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)> Pergunto-me porque...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s sizzling hot in the summer and freezing cold in
the winter?
<$voicel(1,9)>The answer is...<$emotion(1,38)>my body! <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Was that too easy?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>O que é quente escaldante no verão e congelando frio em
O inverno?
<$voicel(1,9)>A resposta é...<$emotion(1,38)>O meu corpo! <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Foi fácil demais?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>I think I digest berries faster than other Pokémon...<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)> Maybe
it’s because my poison’s so strong?
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Even if I eat a ton of berries, I still get hungry again in no
time. <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>It almost feels like I’m wasting berries, y’know?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Acho que digero bagas mais depressa do que os outros Pokémon...<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)> Talvez.
é porque meu veneno é tão forte?
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Mesmo que eu coma uma tonelada de bagas, eu ainda fico com fome novamente em não
Tempo. <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Quase parece que estou desperdiçando bagas, sabe?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>If I ever find a hard berry, I smash it against my body
to break it open before I eat it.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Sometimes the berry splatters a bit and I get kinda sticky...
But <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>that moment it bursts open is just too satisfying!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Se alguma vez encontrar uma fruta dura, esmago-a contra o meu corpo.
para o abrir antes que eu o coma.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Às vezes, as bagas um pouco e eu fico um pouco pegajoso...
Mas... <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Aquele momento em que se abre é muito satisfatório!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>There are lots of good things that come with being tiny,
y’know!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>If someone drops something into a small space, I can go
get it for ’em! And also, <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>I always have plenty of space
no matter where I decide to sleep!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>Há muitas coisas boas que vêm com ser minúsculo,
Você sabe!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Se alguém deixar cair alguma coisa num espaço pequeno, posso ir.
E também, <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Tenho sempre muito espaço.
Não importa onde eu decida dormir!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>I let smaller Pokémon hide behind me when it gets windy
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>so they don’t get blown away!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>You’re welcome to hide behind me too whenever you’re
nearby, <$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Deixei o pequeno Pokémon esconder-se atrás de mim quando ficou ventando.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>para que eles não se deixem levar!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Você é bem-vindo para se esconder atrás de mim também sempre que você está
nas proximidades, <$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Did you know that some berries help soothe burns?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Not that I need them, though!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Sabias que algumas bagas ajudam a acalmar as queimaduras?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas não que eu precise deles!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Where does a river get all of its water from? <$voicel(1,7)>And why does
it never run out?
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Hmmm... I should prolly stop thinking about it, or I’ll
be up all night.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>De onde vem toda a água de um rio? <$voicel(1,7)>E porque é que
Nunca acaba?
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Hmmm... Eu deveria parar de pensar nisso, ou eu vou
Fica acordado a noite toda.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, did you know?! Apparently it can be rainy and sunny
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>AT THE SAME TIME!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ve never seen weird weather like that, though... D’you
think it really exists?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Aparentemente pode ser chuvoso e ensolarado
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ao mesmo tempo!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu nunca vi tempo estranho como aquele, embora...
Achas que existe mesmo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>How do you think the humans made all those machines?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I’ve been thinking and thinking about it but still don’t
have a clue...
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>If I ever meet a human, I’m gonna ask them how they
did it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Como achas que os humanos fizeram todas aquelas máquinas?
